schematic_notes: SOURCE: TI LM7480-Q1 SNOSD95C sections 8/9; candidate analysis in OUTPUT_PROTECTION.md.
FUNCTION REQUIRED: independent OV detection/disconnect and reverse-feed block.
NO DISCONNECT IS FITTED. VOUT_5V1 and VOUT_PROTECTED ARE ELECTRICALLY SEPARATE.
MODIFICATION: reference circuit deliberately not captured until its threshold/let-through budget closes.
RATIONALE: missing load fault-voltage/time and capacitance limits; no unsupported protection promise.
R2 BLOCKER: detector, FETs, trip/recovery and SOA cannot be released yet. No bypass or jumper.
With this draft, VIN cannot power the output. An external LOAD_5V1 supply powers the monitor only.
